description: Official LaTeX template for the PRW (Pattern Recognition Workshop) Proceedings, based on the CVPR/ICCV template. Provides a two-column letter-paper layout with review-mode line rulers and confidentiality banner, paper-ID watermarking, an abstract environment, teaser and subfigure support via cleveref-aware captions, and numbered bracketed citations, based on a custom cvpr document class option package built on the article class.
